title: Findings array on a per-task score
description: Optional structured failure-mode annotations emitted by scorer.score() and stored on RunRecord.score.findings. Each finding's category MUST match an id declared in the arena's manifest under error_categories. The runner redacts content-bearing fields (anchor, evidence, correct_value, examples) on held-out tasks before persisting the record — see contract/README.md.

category.description: Must match an id in arena.yaml#error_categories.

anchor.description: Arena-defined locator into the player's output or the gold (e.g., {page, char_start, char_end}). Stripped on held-out tasks.

evidence.description: Short string showing what the player produced wrongly. Stripped on held-out tasks.

correct_value.description: What the gold said at the same locator. Stripped on held-out tasks. Preserved on public tasks so tool authors can self-train.

count.description: If a finding represents N occurrences (e.g. 12 dropped Greek letters), set count and use examples for representative cases.

examples.description: Short example strings when count > 1. Stripped on held-out tasks.
